parameters.query: SELECT postulacion_id, ticket_id, candidato, email, phone, vacancy_id, vacante, vacante_codigo, estado, prioridad, applied_at, score, prioridad_compatibilidad FROM talentflow.vw_bot_candidatos WHERE candidato ILIKE '%'||$1||'%' OR email ILIKE '%'||$1||'%' ORDER BY applied_at DESC LIMIT 10
